Configuration Reference

Below are the canonical configuration fragments. The pre blocks preserve every space and newline exactly as written — indentation matters for the YAML parser, so the engine must not re-wrap or strip it.

# Example: production gateway configuration
server:
  listen: "0.0.0.0:8443"
  tls:
    cert_file: "/etc/gateway/server.crt"
    key_file:  "/etc/gateway/server.key"
  limits:
    max_connections: 256
    request_timeout_s: 30

logging:
  level: info
  format: json
  rotate:
    max_size_mb: 100
    keep_files: 7

Use --check-config to validate the file before applying it, and --reload to apply changes without a restart. The reload path writes a marker file that the supervisor watches.

$ gatewayctl --check-config /etc/gateway/config.yml
[ OK ]  syntax valid
[ OK ]  tls key matches certificate
[ OK ]  listeners available on 0.0.0.0:8443
[WARN]  logging.rotate.keep_files: 7 is below recommended minimum of 14
  2 warnings, 0 errors

Long single-line commands and log lines also stay on one line inside a pre block; the example below fits the content width.

2024-09-30 21:04:11 INFO  gateway.service: starting, version=2.4.0 build=184 role=primary
2024-09-30 21:04:11 INFO  gateway.tls: certificate loaded, expires=2025-03-30
2024-09-30 21:04:11 INFO  gateway.telemetry: uplink established, host=telemetry.example.net
